title: My new phone
instructions: Leo yeni telefonunu eski telefonuyla karşılaştırıyor. Fiyat ve özelliklere dikkat et.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Yesterday I bought a new phone.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: My old phone was five years old and very slow.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: The new one is bigger, and the camera is much better.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: It cost three hundred pounds. It was expensive, but I saved money for six months.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: I chose a black one, because the white one wasn't in the shop.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Now I can take great photos of my dog!

questions.prompt: Why did Leo buy a new phone?
options: His old phone was very slow.
questions.feedback: Eski telefonu beş yaşındaydı ve çok yavaştı (very slow).
questions.evidence: My old phone was five years old and very slow.

questions.prompt: How much did the phone cost?
questions.feedback: Telefon üç yüz pound (three hundred pounds). Altı, para biriktirdiği ay sayısı.

questions.prompt: Why did Leo choose a black phone?
options: The white one wasn't in the shop.
questions.feedback: Beyaz olan mağazada yoktu, bu yüzden siyahı aldı.
questions.evidence: because the white one wasn't in the shop.
